_comment: Display metadata for bridge tokens on MAINNET: what the UI shows for a
given tokenID. The testnet deployment reads tokenInfos.testnet.json; the file
is picked by the app.isMainnet setting.
This file is the source of truth - adding a token here is enough, no
frontend rebuild and no redeploy. Edits are picked up on the next request
(the file is re-read whenever its mtime changes), so no restart either.
"icon" is the file name of an icon THIS API serves under /icons/tokens/, so
"apex.svg" is loaded from <apiUrl>/icons/tokens/apex.svg. Updating an icon
is an overwrite of that file - browsers revalidate hourly, so it appears
within the hour. Append a query to force it sooner ("apex.svg?v=2" is a new
URL to a browser and the same file to this API). A name with no file behind
it falls back to the UI's bundled unknown icon, as does a missing tokenID.
"iconUrl" overrides "icon" with an absolute URL, for a logo hosted
somewhere else. It must point straight at an image: a github.com/<org>/
<repo>/blob/... link serves HTML and will not render - use the
raw.githubusercontent.com form instead, and note that GitHub caches for
only 5 minutes even for a commit-pinned URL.
"color" is the accent the UI paints the token in (legend dots, chart
series), as a hex string. Optional: a token without one falls back to the
unknownToken color, and to the UI's own default accent if that is unset too.
